title: Approval of Permanent Encroachment Permit with the City of Bishop. The
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Water System
  Approval of Permanent Encroachment Permit with the City of Bishop. The
  Permit will expire fifteen years from the issued date and there is no expense
  to LADWP other than an administrative cost of processing the Permit.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15301.
